name: JPMorgan Chase

Analyst.dsaDepth: Moderate — online assessment (medium–hard LeetCode-style, string/greedy) then a variable-length loop
rounds: Online assessment (HackerRank-style, 1–2 hrs, easy–medium coding plus aptitude)
Technical/code-pair round (live HackerRank or pair programming; questions escalate from syntax to HashMap internals, dependency injection)
System design discussion (e.g. a high-traffic full-stack app or video-streaming service)
Code-review exercise: spot issues in a colleague’s code
Behavioral round (teamwork, conflict, "three words to describe yourself")
extraTopics: Reasoning about WHY something works, not just that it works
Code-review / critique skills, a less common interview format
Analyst.notes: India campus hiring often runs through "Code for Good", a hackathon-based recruiting track.

Associate.dsaDepth: Moderate–Heavy — similar loop with more system design and ownership framing

rounds: Fewer pure-coding rounds; system design, architecture, and technical leadership discussion
VP and above.notes: Thinly documented in public reports; treat as indicative.
